tex_content.label: sec:heat-equation
tex_content.source:
\label{sec:heat-equation}

Let $U\subset\R^n$ be open, $t>0$, and $D=D_x$. The homogeneous and
nonhomogeneous heat equations are
$$(1)\qquad u_t-\Delta u=0,
\qquad
(2)\qquad u_t-\Delta u=f.$$
